The campaign event, ​held today, aimed to visually demonstrate ⁤the ⁢current state ⁢of bus travel in the city – often congested and slow – and contrast it with Mamdani’s vision for a more efficient and accessible public transportation system. Mamdani is currently considered a leading candidate in the mayoral race.
